response.evidence: Supplied source implements single keyed LazyColumn (key(model.selected?.entry?.packageId)) containing top item(NfcPanel + conditional notices/search) and conditional Detail item (or catalogItems). Detail uses non-nested Column(Modifier.padding(vertical=12.dp), verticalArrangement=spacedBy(10.dp)) ending in Spacer(90.dp); no verticalScroll or independent scroller. NfcPanel: active=phase not in {DRAFT,UNRESOLVED_ARCHIVED,CANCELLED}, shows conditional Card only for active phases with controls (approveOverwrite, cancel, archiveUnknown); diagnostic/history buttons always available when data present, launching AlertDialogs with Modifier.heightIn(max=420.dp).verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()). Search field guarded by if(model.selected==null). Matches change description, objective (unified scroll surface, no NFC/M1 changes), and owner requirements (diagnostics/history/saved data remain accessible; active controls visible). layout-build.log, protected32 local tests, lint, assemble all PASS per evidence.
